points.K4: 过滤式与供气式：缺氧用供气式
points.K5: 空气呼吸器：会用才用，留足余量

points.K10: 动力送风呼吸器怎样工作

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣手里拿着一个半面罩呼吸器，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a half-face respirator and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲呼吸防护。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰在台面上称量粉末，粉尘飘起
shots.prompt_en: The young male student weighs a fine powder on an open bench and dust drifts up.
shots.narration: 阿杰在台面上称粉末，粉尘飘起来。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰戴上一个普通薄口罩，觉得够了
shots.prompt_en: He puts on a thin ordinary face mask and gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 他戴了个普通口罩：这下没事了吧？

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研摇头，指向通风柜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student shakes her head and points to a fume hood.
shots.narration: 小研说：口罩可不是随便戴的。

shots.section_title: 空气被污染，就要护呼吸
shots.scene: 空气中飘着粉尘颗粒、蒸气云和气溶胶小点
shots.prompt_en: Dust particles, a vapor cloud and tiny aerosol dots float in the air of a lab. No people.
shots.narration: 粉尘、气体、蒸气、病原，都可能飘在空气里。
overlay: 空气被污染，就要护呼吸

shots.section_title: 空气被污染，就要护呼吸
shots.scene: 细小粉尘顺着气管进入肺部的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of fine dust traveling down the airway deep into the lungs. No people.
shots.narration: 细粉尘能深入肺部，进入血液。

shots.section_title: 空气被污染，就要护呼吸
shots.scene: 空气被污染时，呼吸防护图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: When the air becomes contaminated, a respirator icon lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 空气被污染时，就需要呼吸防护。

shots.section_title: 先靠通风柜，口罩不能代替
shots.scene: 控制层级金字塔，个人防护在最底层
shots.prompt_en: A hierarchy of controls pyramid with personal protective equipment at the bottom. No text.
shots.narration: 呼吸防护用品，是最后一道防线。
overlay: 先靠通风柜，口罩不能代替

shots.section_title: 先靠通风柜，口罩不能代替
shots.scene: 挥发性试剂放进通风柜操作，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A volatile reagent is handled inside a fume hood, with a green check. No faces.
shots.narration: 有挥发性试剂，首先放进通风柜。

shots.section_title: 先靠通风柜，口罩不能代替
shots.scene: 普通口罩前的蒸气直接穿过，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Vapor passes straight through an ordinary face mask, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 普通口罩，挡不住化学蒸气。

shots.section_title: 先靠通风柜，口罩不能代替
shots.scene: 戴口罩在台面上做实验，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A person wearing a mask works at an open bench instead of the fume hood, crossed out. No faces.
shots.narration: 能用通风柜的，口罩不能代替它。

shots.section_title: 按危害选：防颗粒物还是防毒
shots.scene: 防颗粒物口罩和带滤毒罐的面罩并排
shots.prompt_en: A particulate filtering mask and a half-face respirator with gas cartridges side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 呼吸器分防颗粒物和防毒两类滤材。
overlay: 按危害选：防颗粒物还是防毒

shots.section_title: 按危害选：防颗粒物还是防毒
shots.scene: 粉尘、烟尘被防颗粒物滤材拦住
shots.prompt_en: Dust and welding fume particles are caught by a particulate filter. No people.
shots.narration: 粉尘、烟尘、颗粒，用防颗粒物的。

shots.section_title: 按危害选：防颗粒物还是防毒
shots.scene: 蒸气被滤毒罐吸附，颗粒滤材挡不住蒸气
shots.prompt_en: Vapor is captured by a gas cartridge while passing through a particle filter. No people.
shots.narration: 化学蒸气，要用对应的滤毒罐。

shots.section_title: 按危害选：防颗粒物还是防毒
shots.scene: 滤毒罐按颜色图标对应不同气体类别
shots.prompt_en: Gas cartridges with different color bands matched to different gas icons. No text.
shots.narration: 滤毒罐要对上具体的气体种类。

shots.section_title: 按危害选：防颗粒物还是防毒
shots.scene: 焊接烟尘飘向普通口罩，打叉；合格防颗粒物呼吸器打勾
shots.prompt_en: Welding fume reaches an ordinary mask with a red X; a certified particulate respirator gets a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 焊接烟尘，普通口罩挡不住。

shots.section_title: 按危害选：防颗粒物还是防毒
shots.scene: 口罩靠边缘紧贴面部密封，油雾和液体图标打问号
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a respirator sealing around the face edge, with oil mist and liquid icons marked with question marks. No people.
shots.narration: 看清适用范围，有的不防油、不防液。

shots.section_title: 过滤式与供气式：缺氧用供气式
shots.scene: 过滤式：周围空气经滤材吸入；供气式：气瓶送来空气
shots.prompt_en: Two diagrams: air-purifying respirator filtering room air, and supplied-air respirator fed from a separate air source. No people.
shots.narration: 呼吸器分两大类：过滤式和供气式。
overlay: 过滤式与供气式：缺氧用供气式

shots.section_title: 过滤式与供气式：缺氧用供气式
shots.scene: 缺氧环境和高浓度毒气中，过滤式被打叉
shots.prompt_en: In an oxygen-deficient room and a very high toxic gas cloud, the air-purifying respirator is crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 缺氧或浓度极高，过滤式不管用。

shots.section_title: 过滤式与供气式：缺氧用供气式
shots.scene: 消防救援人员背着自给式空气呼吸器
shots.prompt_en: A rescue worker carries a self-contained breathing apparatus on the back.
shots.narration: 自给式空气呼吸器，自己背气瓶。

shots.section_title: 过滤式与供气式：缺氧用供气式
shots.scene: 自给式呼吸器旁的培训合格图标
shots.prompt_en: A self-contained breathing apparatus next to a training certificate icon. No text, no people.
shots.narration: 只用于极端情况，没培训不要戴。

shots.section_title: 过滤式与供气式：缺氧用供气式
shots.scene: 潜水呼吸器和空气呼吸器之间画不等号
shots.prompt_en: A not-equal sign between a scuba breathing set and a self-contained breathing apparatus. No people.
shots.narration: 潜水呼吸器用于水下，不能混用。

shots.section_title: 过滤式与供气式：缺氧用供气式
shots.scene: 王老师把缺氧作业图标指向供气式
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points from an oxygen-deficiency icon to a supplied-air respirator.
shots.narration: 缺氧场所，按规定用供气式。

shots.section_title: 空气呼吸器：会用才用，留足余量
shots.scene: 【实拍】空气呼吸器用前检查：看压力表、试报警哨、查面罩和背带（中景，用训练器材）
shots.prompt_en: A person checks a self-contained breathing apparatus: reads the pressure gauge, tests the whistle, inspects the mask and straps.
shots.narration: 用前查压力、报警哨、面罩和背带。
overlay: 空气呼吸器：会用才用，留足余量

shots.section_title: 空气呼吸器：会用才用，留足余量
shots.scene: 气瓶耗气示意：干活越累，指针下降越快
shots.prompt_en: A cylinder gauge needle drops faster as the wearer works harder. No people.
shots.narration: 干活越累，耗气越快。

shots.section_title: 空气呼吸器：会用才用，留足余量
shots.scene: 报警响起，人员沿出口撤离
shots.prompt_en: An alarm icon sounds and a person in breathing apparatus walks out toward an exit.
shots.narration: 留足撤离余量，报警一响就撤。

shots.section_title: 呼吸防护要成体系，先培训
shots.scene: 风险评估、医学评估、适合性检验、培训四个环节连成一圈
shots.prompt_en: A cycle of four icons: risk assessment, medical check, fit test and training. No text, no people.
shots.narration: 呼吸防护不是发个口罩就完事。
overlay: 呼吸防护要成体系，先培训

shots.section_title: 呼吸防护要成体系，先培训
shots.scene: 阿杰向老周询问要不要戴呼吸器
shots.prompt_en: The young male student asks the older man whether he needs a respirator.
shots.narration: 要不要戴，先问实验室负责人。

shots.section_title: 呼吸防护要成体系，先培训
shots.scene: 医生为学生做医学评估
shots.prompt_en: A doctor examines a student before respirator use. No faces.
shots.narration: 使用前，先由医生评估能不能戴。

shots.section_title: 呼吸防护要成体系，先培训
shots.scene: 王老师讲解选型和佩戴
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches students how to choose and wear a respirator.
shots.narration: 先培训，学会选型和佩戴。

shots.section_title: 呼吸防护要成体系，先培训
shots.scene: 戴呼吸器干活，人出汗；时钟旁是轮换休息图标
shots.prompt_en: A person sweats while working in a respirator; a clock icon next to a rest break icon.
shots.narration: 戴着更累，控制时间，轮换休息。

shots.section_title: 呼吸防护要成体系，先培训
shots.scene: 重型面罩旁的过热温度计图标
shots.prompt_en: A heavy full-face respirator next to a hot thermometer icon. No people.
shots.narration: 重型面罩负担大，可能引起过热。

shots.section_title: 适合性检验：上岗前测，面部变化重测
shots.scene: 不同脸型配不同尺寸的面罩
shots.prompt_en: Different face outlines matched with different respirator sizes. No people.
shots.narration: 每个人脸型不同，面罩要合适。
overlay: 适合性检验：上岗前测，面部变化重测

shots.section_title: 适合性检验：上岗前测，面部变化重测
shots.scene: 适合性检验：头罩里喷有味雾，测试者闻不到
shots.prompt_en: A fit test: a person wearing a respirator sits under a test hood while a mist is sprayed in. No faces.
shots.narration: 往头罩喷有味雾，闻不到才合格。

shots.section_title: 适合性检验：上岗前测，面部变化重测
shots.scene: 日历上首次使用前和定期复检两个标记
shots.prompt_en: A calendar marks a first fit test before use and regular retests later. No text.
shots.narration: 首次使用前做，之后定期复检。

shots.section_title: 适合性检验：上岗前测，面部变化重测
shots.scene: 蓄须、胖瘦变化的脸部轮廓，面罩边缘漏气
shots.prompt_en: Face outlines with a beard and weight change; air leaks around the respirator edge. No people.
shots.narration: 蓄须、胖瘦变化，必须重新检验。

shots.section_title: 每次佩戴，检查密合
shots.scene: 面罩边缘漏气的示意，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Air leaking around the edge of a respirator, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 戴不严，等于没戴。

shots.section_title: 每次佩戴，检查密合
shots.scene: 【实拍】戴好防颗粒物口罩，双手按压鼻夹贴合鼻梁（正面中景，上半张脸不入镜）
shots.prompt_en: A person puts on a particulate respirator and presses the nose clip to fit the bridge of the nose.
shots.narration: 戴好口罩，按压鼻夹贴合鼻梁。

shots.section_title: 每次佩戴，检查密合
shots.scene: 【实拍】双手捂住口罩，用力呼气、吸气，检查边缘是否漏气（正面中景，上半张脸不入镜）
shots.prompt_en: A person covers the respirator with both hands, breathes out and in sharply to check for edge leaks.
shots.narration: 双手捂住，用力呼气吸气查漏气。

shots.section_title: 每次佩戴，检查密合
shots.scene: 边缘漏气，重新调整鼻夹和头带再检查
shots.prompt_en: A leak is found; the nose clip and head straps are adjusted and checked again. No faces.
shots.narration: 漏气就调整，查好了再进去。

shots.section_title: 自愿戴口罩，也要管理
shots.scene: 阿杰拿着防尘口罩想自己戴，王老师递给他使用须知
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a dust mask; the safety administrator hands him a blank instruction sheet.
shots.narration: 自愿戴口罩，也要先讲清须知。

shots.section_title: 自愿戴口罩，也要管理
shots.scene: 口罩挡住视线、脏口罩挂在脖子上，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A mask blocking vision and a dirty mask hanging from the neck, both crossed out. No faces.
shots.narration: 别让口罩妨碍操作或变成污染源。

shots.section_title: 动力送风呼吸器怎样工作
shots.scene: 动力送风头罩：头盔、披肩、滤器、腰带电池一整套
shots.prompt_en: A powered air-purifying respirator set: helmet with filter, hood shroud, belt and battery. No people.
shots.narration: 这是动力送风过滤式呼吸器。
overlay: 动力送风呼吸器怎样工作

shots.section_title: 动力送风呼吸器怎样工作
shots.scene: 空气从侧面吸入，经滤器过滤，风机吹向脸部
shots.prompt_en: Arrows show air drawn in from the side, through a filter, and blown by a fan toward the face. No people.
shots.narration: 侧面进风，过滤后吹向脸部。

shots.section_title: 动力送风呼吸器怎样工作
shots.scene: 头罩内正压，气流从下摆流出形成气幕
shots.prompt_en: Positive pressure inside the hood; air flows out from the lower edge like an air curtain. No people.
shots.narration: 罩内正压，向外的气流挡住脏空气。

shots.section_title: 动力送风呼吸器怎样工作
shots.scene: 风机由腰带上的电池供电
shots.prompt_en: The fan is powered by a battery pack on a belt. No people.
shots.narration: 风机靠电池带动。

shots.section_title: 动力送风呼吸器怎样工作
shots.scene: 有胡子、戴眼镜的人戴宽松头罩，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A loose-fitting hood is worn by a person with a beard and glasses, with a green check. No faces.
shots.narration: 宽松头罩不贴脸，有胡子也能用。

shots.section_title: 动力送风呼吸器怎样工作
shots.scene: 培训合格证图标和风险评估表
shots.prompt_en: A training certificate icon and a blank risk assessment form. No text, no people.
shots.narration: 用哪种，按风险评估，培训合格才用。

shots.section_title: 送风呼吸器用前检查
shots.scene: 电池充满后挂牢在腰带上
shots.prompt_en: A fully charged battery is clipped firmly onto a belt. No faces.
shots.narration: 实验前充满电池，牢牢挂在腰带上。

shots.section_title: 送风呼吸器用前检查
shots.scene: 【实拍】送风呼吸器用前检查：核对滤器、检查连接管和头罩、测送风量（中景，用训练器材）
shots.prompt_en: A person checks a powered air-purifying respirator: inspects the filter, the hose and hood, then tests the airflow.
shots.narration: 查滤器、管路头罩，再测风量。

shots.section_title: 送风呼吸器用前检查
shots.scene: 开机看指示灯全亮，时钟显示续航
shots.prompt_en: The unit is switched on and all indicator lights glow; a clock icon shows battery time. No text.
shots.narration: 开机看灯，续航不够就别进去。

shots.section_title: 送风呼吸器用前检查
shots.scene: 一项不合格，挂上停用牌送修
shots.prompt_en: A failed unit gets an out-of-service tag and is sent for repair. No people.
shots.narration: 有一项不合格，就停用报修。

shots.section_title: 用后去污、充电、登记
shots.scene: 用后擦拭头盔表面去污
shots.prompt_en: The helmet surface is wiped down with disinfectant after use. No faces.
shots.narration: 用完给头盔表面去污。

shots.section_title: 用后去污、充电、登记
shots.scene: 滤器和风机不进水，不泡不冲，接口盖好
shots.prompt_en: Filter and fan kept dry during wiping; soaking and rinsing crossed out; ports capped. No people.
shots.narration: 滤器风机别进水，不泡不冲。

shots.section_title: 用后去污、充电、登记
shots.scene: 沾上溢洒的披肩换新的
shots.prompt_en: A hood shroud stained by a spill is replaced with a new one. No people.
shots.narration: 披肩沾了溢洒，就换新的。

shots.section_title: 用后去污、充电、登记
shots.scene: 电池插上充电器
shots.prompt_en: The battery is placed on a charger. No people.
shots.narration: 用完马上充电，下次才放心。

shots.section_title: 用后去污、充电、登记
shots.scene: 在使用登记本上签字
shots.prompt_en: A person signs a blank usage log next to the equipment. No faces.
shots.narration: 每次使用，签好记录。

shots.section_title: 送风异常，按程序退出
shots.scene: 头罩报警、风变小，操作者停手盖好样品
shots.prompt_en: An alarm light flashes on the hood and the airflow weakens; the worker stops and covers the samples. No faces.
shots.narration: 报警或风变小，先停手盖好样品。

shots.section_title: 送风异常，按程序退出
shots.scene: 在污染区摘头罩打叉，走到指定区域再摘
shots.prompt_en: Removing the hood inside the work area is crossed out; the worker exits to a designated area first. No faces.
shots.narration: 别在污染区摘，按程序退出再摘。

shots.section_title: 送风异常，按程序退出
shots.scene: 两人约定手势：好、停、出去
shots.prompt_en: Two people in hoods agree on hand signals for okay, stop and exit.
shots.narration: 风声大听不清，事先约好手势。

shots.section_title: 滤材按时换，面罩清洁存放
shots.scene: 滤材盒上的有效期和更换记录图标
shots.prompt_en: A filter cartridge with an expiry icon next to a replacement log. No text.
shots.narration: 滤材按说明和规定按时更换。
overlay: 滤材按时换，面罩清洁存放

shots.section_title: 滤材按时换，面罩清洁存放
shots.scene: 闻到异味、呼吸阻力变大，立即离开换滤材
shots.prompt_en: A person notices an odor and harder breathing, leaves the area and changes the filter. No faces.
shots.narration: 闻到异味、呼吸变费劲，马上撤换。

shots.section_title: 滤材按时换，面罩清洁存放
shots.scene: 面罩清洁后装进密封袋，放在干净柜里
shots.prompt_en: A cleaned respirator is sealed in a bag and stored in a clean cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 面罩清洁晾干，密封存放。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 通风柜、选对滤材、密合检查依次打勾
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood, the right filter and a seal check icon get green checks one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 先通风，再选对、戴严呼吸器。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 培训、适合性检验、维护登记依次打勾
shots.prompt_en: Training, fit test and maintenance log icons get green checks one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 先培训检验，用后维护登记。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣指着墙上的一排安全标志，挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a row of safety signs on the wall and waves goodbye.
